Package sc.fiji.snt.gui

Enum Class ContextMenuCommand

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<ContextMenuCommand>
sc.fiji.snt.gui.ContextMenuCommand
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<ContextMenuCommand>, java.lang.constant.Constable
public enum ContextMenuCommand extends Enum<ContextMenuCommand>
Non-editing commands shared by the contextual menus of the tracing canvas and of the Bdv/Bvv viewers: single source of truth for their labels and icons, so that both front-ends expose the same entries. Shortcuts and tooltips are not defined here because they differ between front-ends (e.g., bookmarking is Shift+B in the canvas and M in the viewers). Node-editing commands are defined in NodeEditCommand.
Author:
Tiago Ferreira
